description: Right-side properties panel for the selected diagram element(s). Supports single node, single edge, and multi-selection with collapsible sections.

parameters.name: OnEdgeManualRoutingChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the "Manual routing" checkbox is toggled for an edge. The editor listens so it can seed an empty Waypoints list from the auto-router when the user flips to manual on an orthogonal-like edge — otherwise the edge would collapse to a straight line at the moment of toggle.
